description: This file defines the UserDAO interface, which declares methods for interacting with User entities such as save, list, get, delete, findUserByName, and changePassword.

classes.name: UserDAO
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to User entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a User object to the data store.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User entity identified by its id.

methods.name: findUserByName
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on the username.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a given User.
